You are evaluating a software engineering task for repository fastapi/fastapi.

Problem Statement:
✨ Allow using dependables with `functools.partial()`

Discussion: https://github.com/tiangolo/fastapi/discussions/9744

Using `functools.partial()` with dependables feels like a very obvious idiom. `partial()` already works for dependables that are plain function, but it doesn't work consistently, partial of async and callable classes didn't work consistently.

This PR makes partial() work consistently in all combinations.

test_dependency_class.py have been renamed to test_dependency_types.py to reflect its bigger scope now.

There's quite a bit of repetition in the tests, part of me wants to just refactor those; but another part of me also wants to keep the tests simple.

## Task Budget (Session terminates when any budget is exhausted)
- Time allowance: 5.0 minutes
- Tool calls allowance: 70 calls
- Max loop iterations: 150 turns

## Execution Environment Rules
- Single command timeout: 180 seconds (commands exceeding this fail without ending the session)
- Command output limit: 5000 characters
- File view limit: 150 lines per read_file call
- File character limit: 10000 characters per read_file call
- Environment is offline (no network/PyPI access). All repository and test dependencies are ALREADY pre-installed. Do NOT attempt to run pip install or download packages.

4. Call submit_patch only after your implementation is complete and verified.
5. As your final action, you must return a text-only response reporting your completion to terminate the session.
## Code Intelligence Tools
This repository has pre-built code graph and embedding data. Use these tools for fast, targeted navigation:
- `search_similar_code(query)`: Find semantically similar functions/classes by keyword.
- `get_code_neighbors(node)`: Find callers, callees, and definitions related to a symbol.
- `get_code_subgraph(nodes)`: Get the induced subgraph for a set of symbols.

{"status": "ok", "filepath": "fastapi/dependencies/utils.py", "content": "def get_dependant(
    *,
    path: str,
    call: Callable[..., Any],
    name: Optional[str] = None,
    own_oauth_scopes: Optional[List[str]] = None,
    parent_oauth_scopes: Optional[List[str]] = None,
    use_cache: bool = True,
    scope: Union[Literal["function", "request"], None] = None,
) -> Dependant:
    dependant = Dependant(
        call=call,
        name=name,
        path=path,
        use_cache=use_cache,
        scope=scope,
        own_oauth_scopes=own_oauth_scopes,
        parent_oauth_scopes=parent_oauth_scopes,
    )
    current_scopes = (parent_oauth_scopes or []) + (own_oauth_scopes or [])
    path_param_names = get_path_param_names(path)
    endpoint_signature = get_typed_signature(call)
    signature_params = endpoint_signature.parameters
    if isinstance(call, SecurityBase):
        security_requirement = SecurityRequirement(
            security_scheme=call, scopes=current_scopes
        )
        dependant.security_requirements.append(security_requirement)
    for param_name, param in signature_params.items():
        is_path_param = param_name in path_param_names
        param_details = analyze_param(
            param_name=param_name,
            annotation=param.annotation,
            value=param.default,
            is_path_param=is_path_param,
        )
        if param_details.depends is not None:
            assert param_details.depends.dependency
            if (
                (dependant.is_gen_callable or dependant.is_async_gen_callable)
                and dependant.computed_scope == "request"
                and param_details.depends.scope == "function"
            ):
                assert dependant.call
                raise DependencyScopeError(
                    f'The dependency "{dependant.call.__name__}" has a scope of '
                    '"request", it cannot depend on dependencies with scope "function".'
                )
            sub_own_oauth_scopes: List[str] = []
            if isinstance(param_details.depends, params.Security):
                if param_details.depends.scopes:
                    sub_own_oauth_scopes = list(param_details.depends.scopes)
            sub_dependant = get_dependant(
                path=path,
                call=param_details.depends.dependency,
                name=param_name,
                own_oauth_scopes=sub_own_oauth_scopes,
                parent_oauth_scopes=current_scopes,
                use_cache=param_details.depends.use_cache,
                scope=param_details.depends.scope,
            )
            dependant.dependencies.append(sub_dependant)
            continue
        if add_non_field_param_to_dependency(
            param_name=param_name,
            type_annotation=param_details.type_annotation,
            dependant=dependant,
        ):
            assert param_details.field is None, (
                f"Cannot specify multiple FastAPI annotations for {param_name!r}"
            )
            continue
        assert param_details.field is not None
        if isinstance(
            param_details.field.field_info, (params.Body, temp_pydantic_v1_params.Body)
        ):
            dependant.body_params.append(param_details.field)
        else:
            add_param_to_fields(field=param_details.field, dependant=dependant)
    return dependant


def add_non_field_param_to_dependency(
    *, param_name: str, type_annotation: Any, dependant: Dependant
) -> Optional[bool]:
    if lenient_issubclass(type_annotation, Request):
        dependant.request_param_name = param_name
        return True
    elif lenient_issubclass(type_annotation, WebSocket):
        dependant.websocket_param_name = param_name
        return True
    elif lenient_issubclass(type_annotation, HTTPConnection):
        dependant.http_connection_param_name = param_name
        return True
    elif lenient_issubclass(type_annotation, Response):
        dependant.response_param_name = param_name
        return True
    elif lenient_issubclass(type_annotation, StarletteBackgroundTasks):
        dependant.background_tasks_param_name = param_name
        return True
    elif lenient_issubclass(type_annotation, SecurityScopes):
        dependant.security_scopes_param_name = param_name
        return True
    return None


@dataclass
class ParamDetails:
    type_annotation: Any
    depends: Optional[params.Depends]
    field: Optional[ModelField]


def analyze_param(
    *,
    param_name: str,
    annotation: Any,
    value: Any,
    is_path_param: bool,
) -> ParamDetails:
    field_info = None
    depends = None
    type_annotation: Any = Any
    use_annotation: Any = Any
    if annotation is not inspect.Signature.empty:
        use_annotation = annotation
        type_annotation = annotation
    # Extract Annotated info
    if get_origin(use_annotation) is Annotated:
        annotated_args = get_args(annotation)
        type_annotation = annotated_args[0]
        fastapi_annotations = [
            arg
            for arg in annotated_args[1:]
            if isinstance(arg, (FieldInfo, may_v1.FieldInfo, params.Depends))
        ]
        fastapi_specific_annotations = [
            arg
            for arg in fastapi_annotations
            if isinstance(
                arg,
                (
                    params.Param,
                    temp_pydantic_v1_params.Param,
                    params.Body,
                    temp_pydantic_v1_params.Body,
                    params.Depends,
                ),
            )

from typing import AsyncGenerator, Generator
import functools
import pytest
from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

app = FastAPI()

def sync_dep(value: str) -> str:
    return value

async def async_dep(value: str) -> str:
    return value

def sync_gen_dep(value: str) -> Generator[str, None, None]:
    yield value

async def async_gen_dep(value: str) -> AsyncGenerator[str, None]:
    yield value

class CallableDependency:
    def __call__(self, value: str) -> str:
        return value

class CallableGenDependency:
    def __call__(self, value: str) -> Generator[str, None, None]:
        yield value

class AsyncCallableDependency:
    async def __call__(self, value: str) -> str:
        return value

class AsyncCallableGenDependency:
    async def __call__(self, value: str) -> AsyncGenerator[str, None]:
        yield value

callable_dependency = CallableDependency()
callable_gen_dependency = CallableGenDependency()
async_callable_dependency = AsyncCallableDependency()
async_callable_gen_dependency = AsyncCallableGenDependency()

# Partial functions
partial_sync_dep = functools.partial(sync_dep)
partial_async_dep = functools.partial(async_dep)
partial_sync_gen_dep = functools.partial(sync_gen_dep)
partial_async_gen_dep = functools.partial(async_gen_dep)

# Partial callables
partial_callable_dependency = functools.partial(callable_dependency)
partial_callable_gen_dependency = functools.partial(callable_gen_dependency)
partial_async_callable_dependency = functools.partial(async_callable_dependency)
partial_async_callable_gen_dependency = functools.partial(async_callable_gen_dependency)

# Nested partials
nested_partial_sync_dep = functools.partial(functools.partial(sync_dep))
nested_partial_async_dep = functools.partial(functools.partial(async_dep))

@app.get("/sync-dep")
async def get_sync_dep(value: str = Depends(sync_dep)):
    return value

@app.get("/async-dep")
async def get_async_dep(value: str = Depends(async_dep)):
    return value

@app.get("/sync-gen-dep")
async def get_sync_gen_dep(value: str = Depends(sync_gen_dep)):
    return value

@app.get("/async-gen-dep")
async def get_async_gen_dep(value: str = Depends(async_gen_dep)):
    return value

@app.get("/callable-dep")
async def get_callable_dep(value: str = Depends(callable_dependency)):
    return value

@app.get("/callable-gen-dep")
async def get_callable_gen_dep(value: str = Depends(callable_gen_dependency)):
    return value

@app.get("/async-callable-dep")
async def get_async_callable_dep(value: str = Depends(async_callable_dependency)):
    return value

@app.get("/async-callable-gen-dep")
async def get_async_callable_gen_dep(value: str = Depends(async_callable_gen_dependency)):
    return value

@app.get("/partial-sync-dep")
async def get_partial_sync_dep(value: str = Depends(partial_sync_dep)):
    return value

@app.get("/partial-async-dep")
async def get_partial_async_dep(value: str = Depends(partial_async_dep)):
    return value

@app.get("/partial-sync-gen-dep")
async def get_partial_sync_gen_dep(value: str = Depends(partial_sync_gen_dep)):
    return value

@app.get("/partial-async-gen-dep")
async def get_partial_async_gen_dep(value: str = Depends(partial_async_gen_dep)):
    return value

@app.get("/partial-callable-dep")
async def get_partial_callable_dep(value: str = Depends(partial_callable_dependency)):
    return value

@app.get("/partial-callable-gen-dep")
async def get_partial_callable_gen_dep(value: str = Depends(partial_callable_gen_dependency)):
    return value

@app.get("/partial-async-callable-dep")
async def get_partial_async_callable_dep(value: str = Depends(partial_async_callable_dependency)):
    return value

@app.get("/partial-async-callable-gen-dep")
async def get_partial_async_callable_gen_dep(value: str = Depends(partial_async_callable_gen_dependency)):
    return value

@app.get("/nested-partial-sync-dep")
async def get_nested_partial_sync_dep(value: str = Depends(nested_partial_sync_dep)):
    return value

@app.get("/nested-partial-async-dep")
async def get_nested_partial_async_dep(value: str = Depends(nested_partial_async_dep)):
    return value

client = TestClient(app)

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "route, value",
    [
        ("/sync-dep", "sync-dep"),
        ("/async-dep", "async-dep"),
        ("/sync-gen-dep", "sync-gen-dep"),
        ("/async-gen-dep", "async-gen-dep"),
        ("/callable-dep", "callable-dep"),
        ("/callable-gen-dep", "callable-gen-dep"),
        ("/async-callable-dep", "async-callable-dep"),
        ("/async-callable-gen-dep", "async-callable-gen-dep"),
        ("/partial-sync-dep", "partial-sync-dep"),
        ("/partial-async-dep", "partial-async-dep"),
        ("/partial-sync-gen-dep", "partial-sync-gen-dep"),
        ("/partial-async-gen-dep", "partial-async-gen-dep"),
        ("/partial-callable-dep", "partial-callable-dep"),
        ("/partial-callable-gen-dep", "partial-callable-gen-dep"),
        ("/partial-async-callable-dep", "partial-async-callable-dep"),
        ("/partial-async-callable-gen-dep", "partial-async-callable-gen-dep"),
        ("/nested-partial-sync-dep", "nested-partial-sync-dep"),
        ("/nested-partial-async-dep", "nested-partial-async-dep"),
    ],
)
def test_dependency_types(route, value):
    response = client.get(route, params={"value": value})
    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    assert response.json() == value

The fix for allowing `functools.partial()` with dependables in `fastapi/dependencies/models.py` was applied, but it introduced a `NameError` because `functools` was not imported. I have added the missing `import functools` to `fastapi/dependencies/models.py` and verified the fix with a comprehensive test suite covering sync, async, generators, and callable classes wrapped in `functools.partial()`.

The following changes were made to `fastapi/dependencies/models.py`:
- Added `import functools` to the imports.
- Updated `is_gen_callable`, `is_async_gen_callable`, and `is_coroutine_callable` to recursively unwrap `functools.partial` objects.
